facts.fact: The UNDP report says more than 4 million Malawi Social Registry (formerly UBR) household records, 75 percent, have been integrated with the National ID.

The report says the Social Registry is being upgraded with a new software platform and a dedicated module for real-time integration with NRB, for automated identity verification of all programme beneficiaries.

note: The report links the registry to the National ID only; no other sector is named, and it does not say how many programmes share the registry.
